claim_policy: Packet readiness is not external submission or acceptance. A target becomes submitted or accepted only after a maintainer records an external receipt, review URL, merged PR, or official response.

targets.name: CRAN
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must run final local R checks, inspect CRAN policies, submit through the CRAN web form, and record the CRAN receipt.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark submitted until the CRAN incoming receipt or maintainer confirmation URL/email is stored in registry_submission_receipts.json.
targets.revisit_condition: Refresh after any R package metadata change, CRAN policy change, or failed CRAN pretest.

targets.name: pyOpenSci
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must decide whether to open pyOpenSci review and serve as the long-term review contact.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark submitted until a pyOpenSci software-review issue URL is recorded.
targets.revisit_condition: Refresh after packaging metadata, governance docs, or pyOpenSci scope rules change.

targets.name: rOpenSci
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must decide whether to open rOpenSci review after CRAN posture and R package evidence are current.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark submitted until a rOpenSci software-review issue URL is recorded.
targets.revisit_condition: Refresh after CRAN submission state changes or rOpenSci review policies change.

targets.name: JOSS
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must prepare final JOSS metadata, submit through JOSS, and record the external review URL.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark submitted until a JOSS review issue URL or editor acknowledgement is recorded.
targets.revisit_condition: Refresh after manuscript, citation, archive DOI, or JOSS criteria change.

targets.name: NumFOCUS
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must wait for NumFOCUS application capacity to reopen or record an owner-approved governance deferral.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark submitted until a NumFOCUS application receipt or official response is stored.
targets.revisit_condition: Revisit when NumFOCUS publishes reopened application capacity or requests project material.

targets.name: PyPA
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer should not claim PyPA project submission; keep packaging standards and PyPI evidence current.
targets.receipt_rule: No submission receipt is expected unless PyPA creates an applicable project intake path.
targets.revisit_condition: Revisit only if PyPA project membership rules or Innovate's packaging governance role changes.

targets.name: Apache Arrow
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must decide whether to open Arrow community discussion using the Arrow interchange evidence packet.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark submitted until a mailing-list thread, issue, or official discussion URL is recorded.
targets.revisit_condition: Refresh after Arrow interchange contract, ADR, or Arrow community process changes.

targets.name: .NET Foundation
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must decide whether to initiate .NET Foundation project review after NuGet and governance evidence are accepted.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark submitted until a .NET Foundation application, issue, or official response URL is recorded.
targets.revisit_condition: Refresh after NuGet publication, C# binding support, or .NET Foundation requirements change.

targets.name: Julia community
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must track the Julia General pull request outcome before broader Julia community announcement.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark accepted until the Julia General pull request is merged; record any community announcement URL separately.
targets.revisit_condition: Refresh after Julia General PR state, Julia compat bounds, or installed-package smoke evidence changes.

targets.name: R community
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer must coordinate R community outreach after CRAN and R-universe evidence are current.
targets.receipt_rule: Do not mark submitted until an R community discussion, package review, or announcement URL is recorded.
targets.revisit_condition: Refresh after CRAN, R-universe, or R package evidence changes.

targets.name: scikit-learn-contrib
targets.maintainer_action_boundary: Maintainer should not claim scikit-learn-contrib submission because Innovate scope is broader than estimator add-ons.
targets.receipt_rule: No submission receipt is expected unless project scope changes to a scikit-learn estimator add-on.
targets.revisit_condition: Revisit only if Innovate's scope changes to match scikit-learn-contrib expectations.
